'''Kevin Reitzel Search and Attack Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Reitzel]]
* '''Published:''' July 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]]
* '''Strategy:''' Search and Attack Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Search and Attack Deck Reitzel LS.txt |Download]]
